cat > /workspace/tmp/sandbox_big.py <<'PY'
import json, os, resource, sys, time, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from limits import apply
import subprocess, selectors

data = Path('/workspace/tmp/big_batch.json').read_bytes()
entry = Path('/workspace/submission/main.py')
vendor = Path('/workspace/vendor')
scratch = Path('/workspace/tmp/sbx2'); scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
t0=time.time()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=scratch) as cwd:
    p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(entry)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd=cwd,preexec_fn=apply,close_fds=True,
                       env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C','TMPDIR':str(cwd),
                            'PYTHONHASHSEED':'0','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1',
                            'MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1','NETNOMOS_DEPS':str(vendor)})
    out=b''; err=b''
    # simple: communicate (input small enough for a pipe? 2.5MiB -> must stream) use threads? no: use communicate
    out,err=p.communicate(data)
    rc=p.returncode
after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc',rc,'elapsed %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
print('child maxrss %.1f MiB' % (after.ru_maxrss/1024))
print('stdout MiB %.2f' % (len(out)/2**20))
res=json.loads(out)
for i,r in enumerate(res['results']):
    print(i,'rules',len(r['rules']),'active',len(r['active']),'answers',len(r['answers']), 'sample', json.dumps(r['answers'][0]))
print('stderr', err[-500:].decode())
